note: Block C facade spec (phase 2). Local frame: x along the south facade from the SW corner of the west wing (wall face), y north, z above FFL (ground floor finished level). Metres. Measured by single-view metrology (Scripts/Geo/facade_rectify.py) on photos 061428331/061621646/061624280 and video 070629483; storey height 3.30 m fixed by the facade length (8.88 storeys = 29.4 m vs roof 30.6 m, Bing/OSM) and checked by sills (+0.88), tower landing windows (+8.2/+11.4) and cornice (+13.4).
scale_note: All spec metres were measured with a 3.30 m storey (facade length from the satellite outline; paver lattice and Bing eave length agree within 3.1-3.57 / 3.2-3.4 m). Interior evidence (corridor ceiling 3.1-3.2 m from a 2.10 m door frame, map owner) points to 3.45-3.5 m. After the riser count set scale = storey/3.30 (3.50 -> 1.0606); the builder scales every metric value about the ring centroid, so the block stays centred on the satellite outline. Night check 2026-09-24: (1) person anchor — the woman stepping out of the entrance (rect of 061621646, 155.7 px) stands 1.55 m in front of the door plane (from her foot offset below the threshold with the recovered 0.56 m eye height); corrected height 1.62 m at 3.30 (1.72 m at 3.50; mean for young women here ≈1.60-1.64 with shoes); (2) vestibule door opening 2.20 m at 3.30 (2.33 at 3.50; typical 2.1-2.2); (3) Bing eave length 30.0-31.7 m -> 3.2-3.4. Exterior evidence favours 3.30-3.40; the interior 2.10 m door-frame reading favours ≥3.45. Kept 3.30 until the riser count. | 2026-09-25 facade_fit on 061621646 (0.5x ultrawide, EXIF 12 mm; focal+k1 solved, 13.6 mm-eq, rms 10.8 px, scale from the 12.8 m east-wing length): floor-to-floor 3.24-3.38, mean 3.29 m -> 3.30 kept; F1 sill 1.05 (gauge), window 1.78-1.93 x 1.35-1.40, E columns 1.99/4.61/9.27 (spec 2.02/4.61/9.30), pilaster 11.68 (11.78), cornice underside 13.29 (13.4).
